title: event
description: The `event` content kind (megaplan 1.7 and task 8-A1): one Overlord event the Overlord Console can trigger on a picked spot of the active match area (blackout, EMP, airstrike, traffic jam, supply drop, weather, cyberpsychosis outbreak). One event per file. `cost` is paid in Threat Points when the event is queued. `warning_s` is the seconds between queueing and the hit, during which the players in the area get the sound and the marker (megaplan 8-O1 fairness: never below 3). `cooldown_s` is how long before this same event can be queued again. `radius` is the blocks around the picked spot the effect reaches. `scales_with_intensity` is true when the host-set intensity (Chill, Normal, Brutal) scales the strength of the effect (its counts, power and seconds). `night_city` is true when the event also reaches a host's own Cyberpunk game through the host's hacks, spawns, explosions and toggles (a blackout there is the real `blackout` hack, a traffic jam the real `gridlock`, an airstrike real explosions); it is skipped for a host whose matching guest toggle is off, and for everyone else the event plays in the replica only. An event is guest-caused: every explosion, spawn or hack it makes names the Overlord player as its cause (an airstrike passes the Overlord to the explosion, so ExplosionEvents applies the host's `explosions` toggle and a host with explosions off gets no `explosion` from it). `effect` is exactly one of the shapes below, chosen by `type`: blackout (the lights in the area go dark for `seconds`), emp (devices in the area stop answering and, with `cyberware_off`, a player's active implants go quiet, for `seconds`), airstrike (`strikes` explosions of `power` within `spread` blocks of the spot, one every `interval_ticks`; they use Level.ExplosionInteraction.NONE and never break a block, the replica's or a player's), traffic_jam (a gridlock of the area's traffic for `seconds`), supply_drop (a crate with `eddies` Minecraft eddies, at most 100, and the listed `items`; a drop lands only during an active match and only with opted-in players inside the area, and the Overlord who paid for it cannot open it: never an eddie farm), weather (the match area's weather becomes `weather` for `seconds`) and outbreak (`count` squads of the `spawn_palette` entry `spawn` rush the area; the Night City ones obey the same fairness rules as any spawn). Text is original and short. A file with the same id as a default replaces it.
